prompt: An unstaffed self-service laundromat wants customers to stop leaving finished loads in the machines for hours. No fines, no app or text notifications, no lockers, and no attendant. It must work for customers who do not read the local language.

A weekly food bank wants people to choose their own food without the queue revealing who takes what. No vouchers, no online ordering, and no appointment slots. It runs for two hours in a church hall with six volunteers.

Teach adults to fix a bicycle puncture in a twenty-minute drop-in session at a market stall. No video, no handout, and no instructor demonstration longer than two minutes. Every learner must leave having completed the repair once with their own hands.

Design a way for a person who is hard of hearing to know that someone is at the door of their rented flat. No flashing lights, no phone or wearable, no vibration pad, and nothing that needs wiring or the landlord's permission. It must cost under twenty-five pounds.

Design a scoring mechanic for a four-player competitive board game that removes kingmaking, where a losing player decides who wins. No hidden scores, no player elimination, no catch-up bonus, and final scoring must be countable in under a minute.

Propose a premise for a radio drama about two siblings clearing their late father's garage over one weekend. No hidden will, no secret half-sibling, no flashbacks, and no discovered diary or letters. The conflict must come from what each wants to do with one ordinary object.

Give a premise for a comedy sketch set at the returns desk of a garden centre. No celebrity customer, no romance, no dead plant brought back as a joke, and no manager called over to settle it. The comedy must come from a policy the staff are required to follow.

A volunteer-run choir of thirty keeps double-booking its rehearsal hall with the scout group that shares it. Propose how to stop the clashes. It must cost nothing and need no software beyond what people already have on their phones.
직원이 8명인 작은 사무실에서 하나뿐인 회의실 사용이 자주 겹칩니다. 새 프로그램을 사지 않고 내일부터 바로 쓸 수 있는 방법을 제안하세요.
전통시장이 비 오는 날이면 손님이 절반으로 줄어듭니다. 할인, 쿠폰, 배달 서비스, 지붕 공사 없이 비 오는 날 방문을 늘릴 아이디어를 제안하세요. 상인 대부분이 60대 이상이고 스마트폰 사용에 서툽니다.
아파트 경로당과 바로 옆 어린이 놀이터 사이의 소음 갈등을 줄일 방법을 제안하세요. 이용 시간 분리, 방음벽, 안내문, 주민 회의는 쓰지 않습니다. 예산은 거의 없고 관리사무소 직원은 한 명뿐입니다.
심야 버스 차고지에서 일하는 정비사 두 명을 다루는 단편 드라마의 전제를 제안하세요. 사고, 해고 통보, 숨겨 온 병, 복권 당첨은 쓰지 않습니다. 두 사람은 같은 버스 한 대를 두고 서로 정당하게 다른 것을 원해야 합니다.
